A '''Grappling-Hook Blaster''' was a handheld blaster device that could be used to launch a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] once carried one of these devices.

==Behind the scenes==
The Grappling-Hook Blaster was included with Luke Skywalker's action figure in the [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'']] toy line of [[1995]]. It also features alongside Skywalker's figure in the [[1997]] commemorative limited [[Wikipedia:Hong Kong|Hong Kong]] edition's first set, which includes [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and marks the [[Wikipedia:Handover of Hong Kong|handover]] of Hong Kong from the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]] to the [[Wikipedia:China|People's Republic of China]] that year.<ref name="HK">{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Villians-Set-Limited/dp/B003M40CZE|text=Star Wars - 1997 Limited Hong Kong Commemorative Edition I - Heroes Edition}}</ref>
